messages:
Ashley: Heads-up — planning to onboard `horizon-3b-v2` into the model catalog and pin it to the staging slot tonight. Looking for a deploy owner + someone to run the smoke checklist and be ready to rollback if needed. Window: 2026-05-12 22:00–23:00 UTC.

Vikram: I can own the smoke run. Give me the artifact link and the minimal smoke steps.

Ashley: Thanks. Artifact (s3): https://s3.redwood/models/horizon/3b/v2/model.tar.gz
Commit: 9f3b2ad
Smoke steps (quick):
```
1) deploy to staging-cpu pool (or staging-gpu if needed)
2) run 50 short generation prompts from qa/prompt_sets/horizon_smoke.txt
3) verify latency P50 < 200ms and no NaNs/attn failures
4) sanity-check embeddings on 10 items (cos sim vs baseline > 0.85)
```
Rollback (if bad): `catalog unpin horizon-3b-v2 && catalog pin horizon-3b-v1 --slot=staging`

Claire: For clarity — canary strategy? Do we pin whole slot or do a 10% traffic variant first? If full-pinning, ops should be ready for immediate rollback.

Diego: We should deploy the quantized INT8 variant for perf testing. Is there a quantized build for v2? If not, we should only do a cpu/gpu float smoke.

Ashley: There is an int8 build: `horizon-3b-v2-int8` in the same bucket. I prefer start with 10% canary on staging traffic route if Claire is fine with it. Full pin only after smoke green.

Vikram: 10% canary works. I'll run the smoke script and post the results here. Can someone be on-call for 22:15–22:45 UTC for rollback chatter?

Emily: I can be on-call 22:00–23:00 UTC. Also posted a small PR for the catalog entry (https://git.redwood/repo/pull/482) — needs one more review from infra or eng-ml.

Claire: I'll review the PR now. FYI staging route currently has 5% reserved for experiments, so we may need to coordinate with growth to avoid overlapping canaries.

OpsBot: :calendar: Reservation created — `catalog-window` 2026-05-12T22:00Z to 2026-05-12T23:00Z by Ashley.

Diego: Quick checklist add — confirm KV cache warmup by replaying 200 recent requests to avoid cold-start regressions. I can script that if Vikram wants.

Vikram: Please — that would be helpful. I'll run the smoke + metrics dash checks.

Ashley: Awesome — Diego scripts warmup, Vikram runs smoke, Claire merges PR once reviewed, Emily stands by for rollback. If anything fails post-smoke we do immediate unpin to v1 and open an incident channel.

Emily: Noted. Also tagging @growth to confirm no overlapping experiments before canary. (ping sent)

Claire: PR LGTM. Merging now. :thumbsup:

Vikram: Starting deploy at 21:58 UTC to get canary active by 22:00. Will post a short result summary in ~15min after smoke.

Ashley: Thanks all — drop any quick runbook gaps here. If no objections I'll mark the staging slot and kick off the canary. :shipit:

Vikram: Smoke summary: 50 prompts passed, P50=180ms, P95=410ms, embeddings sanity ok. No errors in logs. Canary at 10% for 20m.

Diego: Cache warmup script ran — ~220 requests replayed. Warm cache lookups stable.

Ashley: Green from me. Let's keep canary running 20m, then we can expand to 50% if no regressions.

OpsBot: :white_check_mark: Canary steady 10% for 20m.

Emily: On rollback readiness — command tested locally, and I have a runbook note in the PR. Will be ready to execute if you call it.

Claire: Coordination note: if we expand to 50% please send a quick message here so growth can adjust experiment allocations.

Vikram: Expanding to 50% now. Will monitor metrics for next 30m.

Ashley: Thanks everyone. Leaving this thread open for any post-rollout anomalies.
